verdict.rationale: The docs say developers can communicate with the agent directly in Slack, that the agent can ask for clarification and report progress, and that it responds to comments that explicitly mention it. The API also has an endpoint to resume a paused agent run. Together these imply conversational steering of an ongoing run, but nothing explicitly documents sending new instructions to an active session mid-run without restarting. Missing for 10: an explicit documented follow-up/message endpoint or SDK method for an active agent run, and hands-on or independent confirmation that mid-run steering works without restarting.
